Job Description

As a Data Scientist within PNC's Data, Modeling & Analytics Marketing & Customer Analytics organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Tysons Corner, VA or Wilmington, DE.

Role Overview:

The Data Scientist - Marketing Valuations will support profitable growth by developing, enhancing, and applying valuation analytics and statistical models to inform marketing decisions.

This role focuses on analyzing customer, offer, and channel economics to generate insights that help guide prioritization, optimization, and investment decisions across marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a solid foundation in statistical modeling and data analysis.

Key Responsibilities:

• Valuation Modeling & Forecasting: Assist in the development and maintenance of valuation and forecasting models, including Net Present Value (NPV), Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and Offer Economics models to support marketing budget and investment decisions.

• Apply statistical and analytical techniques to measure performance, estimate incremental impact, and evaluate business trade-offs.

• Business Analysis & Insights: Analyze customer and marketing data to identify trends, evaluate opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations.

• Analytical Execution: Support the end-to-end analytical process, including data preparation, exploratory analysis, model development, validation, and performance monitoring.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, finance, and data teams to understand business needs, communicate analytical findings, and support implementation of valuation-based recommendations.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.

• Experience in data science, advanced analytics, quantitative modeling, marketing analytics, or a related field.

• Familiarity with marketing valuation concepts, including customer lifetime value, offer economics, marketing measurement, or related analytical methodologies.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL. Exposure to cloud platforms and big data technologies such as Spark or Hadoop is a plus.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be: • Customer Focused: Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. • Managing Risk: Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join our Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering experts within the [1] Applied Technology & AI team. This team is part of Bain's digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

THE ROLE

As a Lead, Full-Stack Data Scientist, you will leverage your experience to design, implement and refine algorithms to extract and use actionable information from multi-modal data across a wide range of industries and business problems. You bring a strong generalist foundation across core data science methods (e.g., statistics, forecasting, optimization, and machine learning) that lets you move fluidly across problem types rather than specializing narrowly in one. You’ll develop and deploy analytical and machine learning models that power production systems such as dynamic personalization and pricing engines, predictive maintenance and always-on forecasting and optimization capabilities.

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Develop data, technology and AI solutions, leveraging a spectrum of techniques including data science, machine learning, AI algorithms to address large-scale enterprise challenges and enable production systems

• Develop and maintain long-lasting models, algorithms, and tools that support internal or client needs

• Collaborate closely with and influence general consulting teams to identify analytics solutions for client business problems and to execute those solutions

• Leverage AI tools with guardrails to accelerate and amplify design, development and implementation phases across the life cycle

• Evaluate where generative AI offers a better path to a client solution, and apply techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and model fine-tuning where appropriate

• Collaborate with technology leaders to develop and advocate for cutting-edge data science concepts to both technical audiences and business stakeholders

• Collaborate with data engineers to ensure data pipelines and platforms support modeling, experimentation, and analytics use cases

• Support data transformations at scale, including cleaning, enriching, de-duping, joining, and correlating structured, semi-structured, or unstructured data for modeling and analysis

• Define and implement new and innovative modeling techniques, experimentation strategies, and analytics workflows within Bain's full model development life cycle, including documentation, unit/integration testing, and reviews

• Support model deployment and operationalization in collaboration with engineering teams, ensuring scalable data science solutions

• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders; lead working sessions, present recommendations, and write crisp technical documentation

• Collaborate with client data engineering and analytics teams and, when needed, contribute to data acquisition, extraction, and preparation to ensure data is fit for modeling and analysis

• Establish and promote best practices for model development, documentation, and reuse, enabling scalable and repeatable approaches across industries and use cases

• Help prioritize and scope data science initiatives by translating complex client business problems into actionable projects with clear execution paths

• Provide technical guidance to external clients and internal stakeholders at Bain

• Contribute to industry-leading innovations that translate into meaningful impact for clients in casework

• Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in data science, and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the capabilities of the analytics platform

ABOUT YOU

Required:

• A strong generalist background with proficiency across core data science methods, including forecasting, statistical modeling, optimization modeling and machine learning

• An interest in applying your expertise across a wide array of industries and problems

• Strong experience working in common data science query and programming languages (Python required, at least working knowledge of SQL)

• Hands-on experience with at least two of the following problem types, with breadth of experience across associated tools and techniques

• Marketing mix modeling (Bayesian regression, causal inference, adstock/saturation modeling)

• Price elasticity and optimization (econometrics, causal inference, optimization)

• Segmentation and personalization (clustering, recommendation systems, experimentation, bandits)

• Supply chain / OR (optimization, simulation)

• Experience building and evaluating LLM-based applications, including prompt optimization

• Experience in AI-native delivery, such as using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate modeling work, generate and test hypotheses, and prototype analytical approaches

• Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering teams to take models into production

• Experience working in agile, cross-functional team environments

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms, and techniques with colleagues and clients

• Curiosity, proactivity, and critical thinking

• Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with both internal leadership and with clients

• Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and complexity, manage priorities, and deliver outcomes independently or with a collaborative team

• Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Econometrics, Statistics or Information Sciences

• 3+ years of experience in advanced analytics or related field

Preferred (non-requisite)

• Working knowledge of Bayesian methods

• Experience deploying ML models using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform) and MLOps tooling such as MLflow and GitHub Actions

• Experience managing data workflows and pipelines for modeling

• Working knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, or similar)

• Experience scaling model training and inference on large datasets, and optimizing pipelines for performance in production environments

• Experience with building complete web apps using coding assistants

• Experience building agentic harnesses and orchestration of agentic processes

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist / Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support a classified government contract. The successful candidate will provide technical expertise in analyzing and interpreting complex data to inform enterprise data management decisions, identify opportunities for the application of Data Science, and develop innovative solutions that address customer mission requirements.

The Data Scientist will support multiple customer organizations and Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO) initiatives by identifying and evaluating opportunities to apply advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to customer data assets. The position will help bridge the gap between mission requirements, data assets, and emerging AI/ML capabilities.

The role requires extensive collaboration with government stakeholders, technical teams, external customers, and IC partners. The Data Scientist will contribute to the development and implementation of technical solutions, support integration of AI capabilities with existing customer data environments, and help establish repeatable approaches for leveraging Data Science across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a Data Science SME providing technical leadership and expertise across customer organizations and mission areas.
• Analyze, interpret, and derive insights from complex, heterogeneous, and large-scale datasets to support mission and enterprise decision-making.
• Identify opportunities to apply Data Science, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to customer mission challenges.
• Assess customer data assets to determine their suitability for advanced analytics and AI/ML applications.
• Support CAIO initiatives by identifying, evaluating, prioritizing, and implementing Data Science and AI use cases.
• Translate mission and business requirements into Data Science problems, analytical approaches, technical requirements, and implementation strategies.
• Develop statistical models, machine learning models, algorithms, and analytical methodologies to address complex customer requirements.
• Design and develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to demonstrate the potential value of Data Science and AI capabilities.
• Support the transition of successful prototypes and analytical capabilities into operational or production environments.
• Integrate AI and Data Science solutions with existing customer data assets, platforms, pipelines, and analytic environments.
• Collaborate with data engineers, data architects, software developers, AI/ML engineers, and other technical personnel to develop end-to-end solutions.
• Provide technical support to other customer organizations seeking to identify and implement Data Science opportunities.
• Coordinate with external customers, mission partners, IC organizations, and other stakeholders to define requirements and develop interoperable technical solutions.
• Participate in technical working groups, design sessions, and collaborative forums focused on Data Science, AI, and enterprise data capabilities.
• Evaluate emerging Data Science, AI/ML, and analytical technologies and recommend capabilities that can improve customer mission effectiveness.
• Assess data quality, availability, structure, provenance, and other characteristics that may affect analytical and AI solution development.
• Identify data management challenges and recommend improvements required to enable effective Data Science and AI applications.
• Develop reusable analytical methodologies, models, frameworks, and technical approaches that can be applied across multiple customer organizations.
• Support development of standards, best practices, and repeatable processes for Data Science experimentation, evaluation, implementation, and operationalization.
• Develop analytical documentation, technical specifications, model documentation, methodologies, and implementation plans.
• Validate analytical models and results and communicate assumptions, limitations, risks, and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Brief government leadership and mission stakeholders on Data Science opportunities, analytical findings, technical approaches, and recommendations.
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor on the application of Data Science and AI to customer data and mission requirements.

Regular
